purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0050 in the relativity arena: the four-line scatter block does not open the fork, it narrows it: tested on states that make its scatterings fire, every beat of the combined knit keeps only symmetries of its head-on base beat, and on the four beats where the base has 4 the block breaks the 2 that carry scatterings outside their sets (8 removed in all), leaving the identity and the point inversion with charge conjugation everywhere; the knit keeps CPT with a period group of order 2 (reducible) and a long-wave anisotropy of 0.84 and 0.81 at sides 9 and 13; and for the head-on beat shape and its free-orientation, orbit-swap relaxation no irreducible period group exists over every subgroup of every beat stabilizer, so a block added on top of those beats cannot make one.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
